notes.title: 🖥️ Multi-Screen Support is Here!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45654904/7f034b56fed766f76dbb69da070f21ce5f6cfc37.png"]
Hey fishers!
You asked... we listened.
Fishing Corner now supports multi-monitor setups!

You can freely drag the island to any screen and play from wherever feels most cozy. Whether you're working on one screen and relaxing on the other, your fisherman will be right where you want him.

⚠️ If you run into any issues, let us know in the Discussions tab or drop us a comment here. We’ll do our best to fix it fast!

The Happyland team
